name: Deciphering The Code: the map marks Ambassador Thargas Anvilmar where he stands (COA-9707)
contract: Issue #9707: Deciphering The Code 175135 is credited and ended by Ambassador Thargas Anvilmar 164389, who stands in the Dun Kazad throne room at (-6443, -320). Its two POIs (objective 0 and turn-in) still pointed at (-6651, -296), about 210 yards away, where he is not.

A real client asks CMSG_QUEST_POI_QUERY (483) and reads SMSG_QUEST_POI_QUERY_RESPONSE (484): quest count, quest id, POI count, then per POI its id, objective index, map, area, floor, priority, flags, point count and points (x, y as int32).
POI 0 has eight points from byte 44; POI 1 starts at byte 108 and its only point is at byte 140. Negative coordinates read as unsigned 32-bit values: -6443 is 4294960853 and -320 is 4294966976.

The quest diamond comes from QuestSuperTrack 33057 -> SuperTrack nodes 21552 (objective) and 21553 (turn-in), which the client placed at the old spot. With CoA.SendDisplayPatches=1 the login stream sends coa_client_super_track rows as SMSG_PATCH_SUPER_TRACK (0x06BE = 1726) records: ID, map, x, y, z as float words. Socketless packet construction does not establish how the client renders the diamond.
